supplements.title: Farnesol induces apoptosis, LC3B/SQSTM1 mediated regulation of autophagy and downregulates anaerobic Glycolysis through suppression of LDH and PKM in A549 lung adenocarcinoma cells.
supplements.summary: Farnesol inhibits lung cancer cell growth by disrupting glycolysis, triggering mitochondrial dysfunction, increasing oxidative stress, and promoting cell death.

supplements.title: Selective cytotoxicity of solamargine via oxidative stress and caspase-independent mechanisms in human glioblastoma cells.
supplements.summary:
Here's a summary sentence focused on the key finding about solamargine's effect on glioblastoma cells:

Solamargine selectively reduces glioblastoma cell viability by inducing oxidative stress and DNA damage through a non-apoptotic mechanism.

supplements.title: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) targets liver cancer stem cells via inhibiting Hedgehog signaling pathway in hepatocellular carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Ashwagandha extract effectively inhibited liver cancer cell proliferation and reduced drug resistance by targeting cancer stem cells through the Hedgehog signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Combination of sodium pentaborate pentahydrate, curcumin and piperine treatment induces ferroptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma cells by regulating iron homeostasis and ROS activity in vitro.
supplements.summary: A combination of sodium pentaborate, curcumin, and piperine effectively triggered cell death in hepatocellular carcinoma by disrupting iron metabolism and increasing reactive oxygen species.

supplements.title: Impact of yoga therapy in intestinal disorders.
supplements.summary:
Here's a concise summary sentence:

Yoga therapy may offer potential relief and improve quality of life for patients with intestinal disorders like IBS, IBD, and colorectal cancer.

supplements.title: [Consensus document on healthy lifestyles].
supplements.summary:
Since this is a consensus document on healthy lifestyles rather than a cancer research paper, I'll provide a general summary highlighting the key lifestyle recommendations:

A comprehensive guide recommends balanced nutrition, regular exercise, stress management, and social support to promote overall health and prevent chronic diseases.

supplements.title: Rebalancing the inflammatory trajectory from inflammatory bowel disease to colitis-associated colorectal cancer via artemisinin-based multitarget therapy.
supplements.summary: Artemisinin compounds show promise in reducing inflammation and cancer progression in inflammatory bowel disease, potentially preventing colorectal cancer development.

supplements.title: Synergistic Triple-Modal Nanoplatform Integrating Fluorescence Imaging and Chemo-Photothermal/Photodynamic Therapy for Targeted Cancer Treatment.
supplements.summary: A novel nanoplatform combining targeted drug delivery, fluorescence imaging, and light-activated therapies shows promising potential for precise cancer treatment.

supplements.title: Dioscin Suppresses Ovarian and Gastric Tumor Progression by Inhibiting ALDH1A3-Mediated Retinoic Acid Metabolism and Cancer Stemness.
supplements.summary: Dioscin, a natural compound, inhibits cancer stem cell activity in ovarian and gastric tumors by blocking a key enzyme involved in tumor progression and drug resistance.

supplements.title: Eupafolin in Nature and Science: Occurrence, Chemistry, Biosynthesis, Analytical Methods, and Potential Multifaceted Applications.
supplements.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

Eupafolin, a flavonoid found in medicinal plants, shows promising anticancer and anti-inflammatory properties with potential therapeutic applications.

supplements.title: Transcriptomic profile and gene expression of human breast cancer cell lines treated with herbal extract of clinacanthus nutans leaves.
supplements.summary: Clinacanthus nutans leaf extract induced apoptosis in breast cancer cells by altering expression of 843 genes involved in cell death pathways.

supplements.title: Ultrasound-Enhanced Delivery of the Quercetin Derivative ANL3 Activates the FOXO1A-NDRG2-SOD2 Axis to Induce Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress in Osteosarcoma.
supplements.summary: Ultrasound-assisted delivery of a new quercetin derivative (ANL3) effectively triggers cancer cell stress and death in osteosarcoma by targeting specific cellular pathways.

supplements.title: Bone-Penetrating Copper-Coordinated Nanoassembly Elicits Cuproptosis for Multimodal Cancer Therapy.
supplements.summary: A copper-based nanoparticle platform effectively treats melanoma by inducing cancer cell death and penetrating bone tissue, achieving a 75% cure rate with low-dose light therapy.

supplements.title: Glucosamine suppresses hepatocellular carcinoma progression through dual inhibition of cell cycle progression and nucleotide metabolism.
supplements.summary: Glucosamine inhibits liver cancer growth by stopping cell division and disrupting energy metabolism, potentially enhancing the effectiveness of existing cancer treatment.

supplements.title: 4-Hydroxyderricin from Angelica keiskei promotes the stability of BRCA1 in triple-negative breast cancer cells through inhibition of cathepsin S.
supplements.summary: A compound from Angelica keiskei helps stabilize BRCA1 protein in triple-negative breast cancer, potentially improving chemotherapy effectiveness by blocking cathepsin S.

off_label.title: Successful Everolimus Therapy for Atrioventricular Block Due to Cardiac Rhabdomyoma Associated With Tuberous Sclerosis Complex.
off_label.summary: Everolimus effectively reduced a cardiac tumor in a tuberous sclerosis patient, resolving potentially life-threatening heart rhythm disruption caused by tumor compression.

off_label.title: Transcriptomic Correlation Identifies Cell Model Representatives for MYCN-Amplified Pediatric Neuroblastoma, Downstream Impact of Model Choice on Functional Interpretation, and Potential Drug Repositioning Candidates.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified specific neuroblastoma cell lines that closely match patient tumor gene expression, revealing potential new drug treatments for MYCN-amplified, high-risk pediatric cancer.

off_label.title: Safety of anagliptin/metformin combination tablets evaluated by non-inferiority between pre- and post-serum lactic acid levels in Japanese patients with type 2 diabetes and moderate renal impairment (AMELIO STUDY).
off_label.summary: A study found anagliptin/metformin combination tablets are safe for Japanese type 2 diabetes patients with moderate kidney problems, based on stable lactic acid levels.

off_label.title: Giant Cell Arteritis/Polymyalgia Rheumatica and Atypical Pulmonary Carcinoid Tumor: A Paraneoplastic Syndrome?
off_label.summary: A 59-year-old man with giant cell arteritis developed a rare paraneoplastic syndrome linked to a small-cell lung neuroendocrine carcinoma.

off_label.title: A novel DYRK1A inhibitor alleviates lipopolysaccharide-induced acute lung injury via suppressing inflammatory pathway.
off_label.summary: A new drug targeting DYRK1A effectively reduces inflammation and damage in acute lung injury, potentially offering a promising treatment approach.

off_label.title: Insight into the Biology of Hepatitis B Virus and Recent Therapeutic Approaches.
off_label.summary:
Here's a concise summary sentence:

Researchers review hepatitis B virus biology and explore new antiviral strategies to improve treatment and develop more effective vaccines against liver cancer.

off_label.title: Aging clocks delineate neuron types vulnerable or resilient to neurodegeneration and identify neuroprotective interventions.
off_label.summary: In C. elegans, ciliated sensory neurons age faster, and their degeneration can be slowed by drugs like syringic acid and vanoxerine that inhibit protein translation.

off_label.title: New mechanistic insights into targeted protein degradation using Raman-active theranostic hydrophobic tags.
off_label.summary: A new hydrophobic tag coupled with olaparib more effectively degrades PARP-1 in ovarian cancer cells, enhancing anti-cancer activity through targeted protein removal.

off_label.title: Exploring dual inhibitors Carbonic Anhydrases and Phosphodiesterase 5 as potential agents for treatment Alzheimer's disease.
off_label.summary: A novel dual-targeting drug compound 8a shows promise in reducing memory loss and brain cell damage in Alzheimer's disease by inhibiting two key enzymes.

off_label.title: Evaluation of metformin's effect on 5-fluorouracil-induced cardiotoxicity through cellular protection.
off_label.summary: Metformin may protect heart cells from damage caused by 5-fluorouracil chemotherapy, potentially reducing toxic side effects during cancer treatment.

off_label.title: Repositioning GLP-1 Receptor Agonists in Endometrial Cancer: Molecular Rationale, Preclinical Insights, and Translational Opportunities.
off_label.summary: GLP-1 receptor agonists show promise in treating endometrial cancer by targeting tumor growth and metabolic dysfunction in obesity-related cases.

off_label.title: HDAC Inhibition Triggers Release of RNA Polymerase II from Promoter-Proximal Pausing in Healthy Blood Progenitors and Primary Acute Myeloid Leukemia Myeloblasts.
off_label.summary: HDAC inhibitor SAHA triggers RNA polymerase release in both healthy and acute myeloid leukemia cells, potentially explaining limited clinical effectiveness.

off_label.title: Pharmacogenomic Synthetic Lethal Screens Reveal Hidden Vulnerabilities and New Therapeutic Approaches for Treatment of NF1-Associated Tumors.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified 23 drugs that selectively kill NF1-deficient Schwann cells, revealing promising therapeutic approaches for neurofibromatosis type I-associated tumors.

off_label.title: Repurposing of the Macrolide Antibiotic Clarithromycin for the Prevention of Lung Cancer.
off_label.summary: In a mouse model, the antibiotic clarithromycin prevented KRAS-mutant lung cancer by reducing inflammation and altering the microbiome.

off_label.title: Delactylation of the tumor suppressor ARHGDIB drives metastasis and chemoresistance in bladder cancer.
off_label.summary: In bladder cancer, HDAC2-mediated removal of lactylation from ARHGDIB promotes cancer spread and cisplatin resistance by activating DNA repair mechanisms.

biomarkers.title: Time-resolved simultaneous imaging of mitochondrial reactive oxygen species and lysosomal permeabilization to determine organelle-centred cell death.
biomarkers.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

Researchers developed a new imaging technique to simultaneously track mitochondrial and lysosomal changes during cell death, revealing potential insights for understanding cellular destruction.

biomarkers.title: Evaluation of targeted and immune combination therapies in a rat model of hormone receptor-positive breast cancer.
biomarkers.summary: In a rat breast cancer model, fulvestrant combined with an immune checkpoint inhibitor showed the most effective tumor regression and treatment response.

biomarkers.title: Switchable Electrode-Enabled High-Density Two-Dimensional Chips: A Simple, Generalizable Approach to Yield High-Throughput Electrochemical Analyses.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a microfluidic chip with switchable electrodes that successfully monitored cancer cell (MDA-MB-231) proliferation through a high-density, compact sensor design.

biomarkers.title: Harnessing the role of insulin-like growth factor in glioblastoma: a comprehensive review.
biomarkers.summary: Targeting the IGF system, particularly IGFBP-2 and its signaling pathways, may offer a promising therapeutic approach for treating aggressive glioblastoma.

biomarkers.title: An Eye-Opening Approach: Cancer of Unknown Primary Source With Choroidal Metastasis Case Report.
biomarkers.summary: A 33-year-old patient with choroidal metastasis from lung cancer achieved long-term disease control through multimodal treatment combining immunotherapy, chemotherapy, and targeted radiation.

biomarkers.title: DNA origami vaccines program antigen-focused germinal centers.
biomarkers.summary: DNA origami nanoparticles displaying an HIV envelope protein effectively primed rare B cells that could generate broadly neutralizing antibodies in mouse models.

biomarkers.title: KMT2C Loss Promotes NF2-Wildtype Meningioma Progression and Ferroptosis Sensitivity via Epigenetic Repression of Hippo Signaling.
biomarkers.summary: KMT2C loss in NF2-wildtype meningiomas promotes cancer progression by reducing NF2 transcription and increasing sensitivity to cell death.

biomarkers.title: Isolation and characterization of broadly-neutralizing anti-HCMV-gB antibodies from human donors using a prefusion-stabilized HCMV gB variant.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers isolated new antibodies targeting human cytomegalovirus (HCMV) using a modified viral protein, revealing potential strategies for preventing and treating HCMV infections.

biomarkers.title: SIRT7 as a context-dependent biomarker and therapeutic target: Insights from a pan-cancer study.
biomarkers.summary: In a pan-cancer study, SIRT7 was found to have context-dependent roles in cancer progression, with potential as a biomarker and therapeutic target across multiple cancer types.

biomarkers.title: TGF-β1 relieves burn injury induced pain by alleviating inflammation in mouse.
biomarkers.summary: TGF-β1 reduces pain and inflammation in burn injury by suppressing pro-inflammatory factors and promoting anti-inflammatory responses in a mouse model.

biomarkers.title: Laboratory diagnostics and follow-up of medullary thyroid cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers highlighted the diagnostic challenges of measuring biomarkers in medullary thyroid cancer, emphasizing the need for standardized testing and careful interpretation.

biomarkers.title: Prognostic role of interim F-18 fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography-computed tomography during chemoradiation therapy in patients with hypopharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: In patients with hypopharyngeal cancer, smaller reductions in tumor metabolic activity during chemoradiation predict higher disease recurrence risk.

biomarkers.title: ITIH2 in colorectal cancer metastasis: Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis-guided functional validation.
biomarkers.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

ITIH2, a newly identified gene, plays a key role in colorectal cancer's spread to the liver by influencing cellular processes.

biomarkers.title: Hidden risks associated with occupational pesticide exposure in women with breast cancer: High frequency of the Luminal B molecular subtype and occurrence of poor prognostic features.
biomarkers.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

Women exposed to pesticides in agricultural settings showed increased risks of developing an aggressive Luminal B breast cancer subtype with poor prognostic features.

biomarkers.title: Mixed effects of complement in a chronic murine model of inflammatory erosive arthritis and pulmonary vascular disease.
biomarkers.summary: In a TNF-transgenic mouse model, complement deficiency did not significantly reduce inflammatory arthritis or pulmonary disease, but may slightly delay bone erosions.

trials.title: A hybrid feature extraction framework combining PCA and mutual information for gene expression based lung cancer classification.
trials.summary: A hybrid PCA-MI approach successfully extracted key gene features from lung cancer data, enabling a CNN classifier to achieve 98% accuracy.
